[b]Changes:[/b] The playerlist can now no longer be opened when on a tutorial map.
[b]Changes:[/b] An error message will now appear when encountering a network error.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved a bug where all screen widgets would disappear when a session failed to host.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where the ban button would cease to function.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where the host would show up as a banned player.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where lobbies could not be found when using a minimum available slots value of 1 or higher.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where the "Mad Dog Style" body outfit did not have any mipmaps.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Addressed a bug where Steam friends' profile images would not load correctly when opening the friend menu for the first time.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where full-body particle effects did not correctly follow the forearms.

[h2]Performance:[/h2]
[b]Performance:[/b] Made some minor performance improvements.

[h2]Removed:[/h2]
[b]Cleanup:[/b] Removed some unused code.
[b]Cleanup:[/b] Removed some unused plugins.

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[b]Issue:[/b] Clients show up with the incorrect username on the tab-menu for the host.
[b]Issue:[/b] Server ping consistently displays as 9999 ms.
[b]Issue:[/b] Clients show up in chat with the wrong username upon leaving.

[i]Note: If you encounter issues with seeing yourself as a banned player, you can resolve it by deleting the BannedPlayers.sav file while the game is running.[/i]

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[b]Added:[/b] Five new welcome texts have been introduced.
[b]Improvement:[/b] Now, encountering an error will automatically remove the connecting and creating server screens, streamlining the user experience.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where lobbies would not appear in the server browser as intended.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where clients would erroneously join with the wrong username.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Addressed a bug where getting kicked for any reason would render the user unable to host lobbies until a game restart.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where users could interact through the connecting screen.
[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where users could interact through the creating server screen.

[h2]Cleanup:[/h2]
[b]Cleanup:[/b] Removed some unused code.
[b]Cleanup:[/b] Eliminated some unused maps from the game.

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[b]Issue:[/b] Clients may not display correctly on the tab-menu for the host.
[b]Issue:[/b] Server ping consistently displays as 9999 ms.
[b]Issue:[/b] The ban button is currently non-functional.
[b]Issue:[/b] The host may appear as a banned player.

[i]Note: If you encounter issues making your lobby visible for others, please ensure that your firewall settings are not blocking access, or consider port-forwarding to enable your lobby to appear in the server browser. Joining friends via invites or the join button should work without issues.
[/i]

Thank you for playing!
